title: Payment of the Passed-Through Permit Fee — Ridgeline Installation Services
content:
Whether the customer of a Ridgeline Installation Services contract has paid the passed-through permit fee sets the permit-payment share of the permit handling fee.

**Clause.** Permit-payment share of the permit handling fee: when the payments made on the contract for fees cover the permit fee at cost, the paid-permit share of 0.9 applies; when they do not and more than the unpaid-permit days of 30 have passed since the date of the permit fee line, the unpaid-permit multiple of 1.1 applies; otherwise the permit-payment share is 1.

The permit handling fee is multiplied by the permit-payment share; neither the share nor any amount formed on the way to the permit handling fee is rounded, the permit handling fee being rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Terms used

- **The permit fee at cost** is every permit fee line charged on the contract, added together.
- **Payments made on the contract for fees** are the payment lines whose purpose is fees, added together; deposits, progress, change order and final payments do not count.
- **Cover** means the fee payments are at least the permit fee at cost.
- **Days since the permit fee line** are the calendar days from the date of the most recent permit fee line to today.

| Fee payments compared with the permit fee at cost | Days since the permit fee line | Permit-payment share |
|---|---|---|
| at least equal | any | 0.9 |
| below | more than 30 | 1.1 |
| below | 30 or fewer | 1 |

On a contract with no permit fee line, the permit fee at cost is 0.00 and the permit-payment share is 1.

## Worked figures (hypothetical permit fee at cost 180.00)

| Fee payments | Days since the permit fee line | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 180.00 | 45 | 0.9 |
| 100.00 | 31 | 1.1 |
| 100.00 | 30 | 1 |
| 0.00 | 12 | 1 |
